issue.title: Toggling auto-approve off in the TUI does not stop an already-running bare-%auto agent from auto-approving

task_type_fields.impact: Users toggling auto-approve off mid-run get a disabled row/toast while the agent's next plan is still auto-approved; the TUI state lies about the runner.
task_type_fields.location: src/sase/main/plan_approve_handler.py:get_auto_plan_approval_action/is_auto_approve_active consult SASE_AGENT_AUTO_APPROVE env before agent meta; env set at src/sase/axe/run_agent_runner_launch.py:259
task_type_fields.repro: Launch an agent with bare %auto, then on the Agents tab select the RUNNING row and press A to toggle off. agent_meta.json loses approve and the prompt loses the %auto line, but the live runner process still has SASE_AGENT_AUTO_APPROVE=1 in its environment, so get_auto_plan_approval_action()/is_auto_approve_active() keep returning approve for its next plan. Confirmed by code inspection during the Agents-tab A-toggle implementation (plan 202609/agents_a_key_bare_auto_toggle.md); the deleted menu Disable path had the same limitation.
